text:
Anya: quick sync — we need to finalize auth surface for the next API iteration. customers keep asking for per-project keys + seamless rotation without downtime.
Sam: +1. main tradeoff is complexity in routing + telemetry. do we want project-scoped keys or token-scoped scopes?
Carla: clients want both: project keys for delegation within orgs, and short-lived session tokens for end-user flows. rotation must be safe for long-running chats (KV caches, streaming).
Rajesh: important: Dedicated/Private customers expect rotation hooks to integrate w/ their KMS. we can't force short TTLs there. needs policy-based rotation window.
Anya: right. proposal: 3 key types: org-master, project-key (can be restricted by route/model), ephemeral session tokens (user-level, TTL <= 1h).
Sam: how do we handle caching + KV invalidation on rotation? if a project-key is rotated, ongoing sessions using that key need to continue until end of conversation or be seamlessly re-authenticated.
Carla: technical idea: mint ephemeral session token signed by new key; runtime accepts either active key OR a valid short-lived session signed by the org-master until session end. fallback window = 15m.
Rajesh: ops concern: Private deploys can't accept external signing. need a webhook so customer KMS can sign session tokens locally. we should add a plugin interface.
Anya: launch criteria we should require: 1) doc for key models + migration guide, 2) API to rotate keys with async status, 3) telemetry to map usage to old/new keys, 4) client SDK helpers for session tokens.
Sam: and we need behavior for tool / function calls. when a model triggers external tool calls, which identity is used? project-key or ephemeral user token? this affects RBAC and audit logs.
Carla: default: tool calls should use project-key context for access control; ephemeral tokens can request delegation and must be explicitly granted by the project scope.
Rajesh: also think about rate limits and quotas during rotation. if we fail over to fallback model variant, billing attribution must stay consistent. include token-level tagging in logs.
Anya: customer asks: ability to rotate without updating thousands of devices. we should expose a rotation plan API: <initiate rotation> -> generate new key -> set active window -> swap with zero-downtime path (accept both keys for session window).
Sam: need edge cases: what if old key is compromised? allow immediate revoke that invalidates existing ephemeral tokens but keeps ongoing sessions? contradictory. maybe revoke_all flag that force-kicks sessions. document implications.
Carla: UX: console should show "rotation safety" warnings: if revoke_all used, system will terminate streaming responses and invalidate caches. :warning:
Rajesh: testing matrix: Hosted (fast TTLs), Dedicated (customer KMS integration), Private (air-gapped). each needs test scenarios for: rotate-without-downtime, revoke_immediate, session-resume, tool-calls-auth, telemetry continuity.
Anya: prioritized list for next sprint: 1) spec for key types + APIs (Sam), 2) SDK helpers for session tokens (Carla), 3) KMS webhook spec for Private (Rajesh), 4) docs + migration guide (Product).
Sam: estimated effort: spec 3d, SDK 5d, KMS webhook 5d, docs 2d. can we ship a beta with hosted + dedicated first?
Rajesh: yes, but gating: Dedicated needs opt-in KMS integration; Private will be alpha. add feature flag and canary rollout.
Carla: acceptance criteria for beta: rotation API works w/o increasing 95th pct latency >5%, client SDK can rotate with <1s disruption for streaming, telemetry maps token->project for both old/new keys.
Anya: ok let's capture those in GH issue and backlog. Sam/Carla/Rajesh own the PRD sections. I'll draft migration guide and coordinate with infra on rollout windows.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/keys-rotation-spec -> staging (CI 14 checks)
Sam: noted. will start spec doc today and ping design for console flows.
Carla: I'll prototype SDK helper patterns for JS + Python with examples for function-calling delegation.
Rajesh: I'll draft KMS webhook contract and list required audit events.
Anya: thanks team. we'll reconvene after spec draft. :thumbsup:
